notes: A section is now chosen from a drop-down everywhere in the app — one field that opens the list, the same size and shape in every portal, with a search box once a school has more than nine sections.
Class schedules are set per term. The coordinator fills in Term 1, Term 2 and Term 3 in the Sections tab, and each portal shows the timetable of whichever term is activated in Tagging.

Work a learner hands in is renamed as it is sent: SURNAME_SUBJECT_ACTIVITY, with a short name for each subject, so a teacher can tell one piece of work from another without opening any of them. It applies to every class card, the advisory class included.
notes_fil: Sa buong app, ang seksiyon ay pinipili na sa isang drop-down — isang field na nagbubukas ng listahan, pare-pareho ang laki at hugis sa bawat portal, at may hanapan kapag higit sa siyam ang seksiyon ng paaralan.
Itinatakda na ang iskedyul ng klase bawat termino. Pinupunan ng coordinator ang Term 1, Term 2 at Term 3 sa Sections tab, at ipinapakita ng bawat portal ang iskedyul ng terminong binuksan sa Tagging.

Pinapalitan ng pangalan ang gawaing ipinapasa ng mag-aaral habang ipinapadala: APELYIDO_ASIGNATURA_BILANG NG GAWAIN, may maikling pangalan ang bawat asignatura, para matukoy ng guro ang bawat gawain nang hindi binubuksan ang alinman. Umiiral ito sa bawat class card, kasama ang advisory class.
